title: Freelancer INI basics
summary: How Freelancer INI files are built from sections, keys, values and repeated entries.

blocks.text: Freelancer files look like classic INI files, but they often use repeated keys, loose ordering and comments as important orientation. Atlas must preserve this structure when saving files.

blocks.title: When editing
items: Do not remove or move comments
Treat repeated keys as multiple values
Respect line endings, especially in CRLF files

blocks.title: Typical section
blocks.text:
[Object]
nickname = Li01_to_Li02
ids_name = 260642
pos = -33220, 0, -27930
archetype = jumpgate
